verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's own marketing describes a checklist that runs from start to approval, clean workflows with status dashboards, and hands-on help gathering evidence, which touches the structured-collection core. It never describes how documents actually move, so it is unclear whether a portal replaces email attachments. missing for 10: documented upload/portal mechanism, automated reminders, detail on how the evidence checklist works, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments
